latHint: Think a bracelet with tiny trinkets dangling from it.
pivHint: Paul says that God WORKS for the good of those who love him. When something succeeds perfectly the first time, we say it WORKS like a ______.
winText: You found it. WORKS isn't just what God does for our good. When something succeeds perfectly, it WORKS like a CHARM.
lossText: The word was CHARM. WORKS was the pivot. When something succeeds perfectly the first time, we say it WORKS like a CHARM.
votdVerse: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
passageText: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us through wordless groans. And he who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for God’s people in accordance with the will of God. And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
